name: 北森办事入口
description_zh: 北森 HR 业务办理导航入口。根据用户意图智能匹配业务菜单，一键唤起入职办理、转正申请、调动流程、离职手续等 HR 业务操作页面。让办事不再迷路。
description_en: Smart navigation portal for Beisen HR services. Automatically matches service menus based on user intent — onboarding, confirmation, transfer, offboarding, and more. Never get lost in HR workflows again.
